results.title: AI In 2026: 10 Predictions On Automation And The Future Of Work
results.content: [Innovation](https://www.forbes.com/innovation/)[AI](https://www.forbes.com/ai/). # AI In 2026: 10 Predictions On Automation And The Future Of Work. So, my AI predictions for 2026 (and beyond). The billions in spending to enable growth for [growth’s sake](https://fortune.com/2024/05/03/openai-sam-altman-microsoft-agi-artificial-general-intelligence-costs/) causes concerns of an AI bubble. Furthermore, some of this investment is becoming circular - for example [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-18/microsoft-nvidia-to-invest-up-to-15-billion-in-anthropic?embedded-checkout=true) reported in November 2025 a $15 billion investment by Nvidia and Microsoft in Anthropic so that it can scale its Claude AI model (by buying Microsoft and Nvidia products). Most AI funding is being spent on bigger and better LLMs. However, Yann LeCun, the 2018 Turing Award winner who resigned as Meta's Chief AI Scientist in November 2025, argues that LLMs lack the capability to form [AGI's technological foundation](https://www.businessinsider.com/meta-ai-yann-lecun-llm-world-model-intelligence-criticism-2025-11). In September 2025, [Saleforce’s CEO](https://www.salesforceben.com/ai-agents-drive-4000-job-cuts-in-salesforce-support-division/) announced the reduction of 4000 jobs in customer support due to a greater reliance on AI agents. Reports of AI detectors flagging the [Declaration of Independence as 98.51% AI-generated](https://www.forbes.com/sites/jodiecook/2024/07/04/ai-content-detectors-dont-work-the-biggest-mistakes-they-have-made/) highlight their flaws.
